svg.text: lights-out — the quiet mission: the radio codebook · ▲ a start (blue dot = the partner) · ■ a place it can be · ○ a way out · magenta = a camera's cone · orange dot = a light (hollow = off)
a beat = a dashed loop; a filled dot = where he stands, the stub = the way he faces there, the number = seconds stood
beats: north · east · cook · north_b · east_b · cook_b
